about.description: Sitar Indian Cuisine is one of the finest Indian restaurant located at Huntsville, AL. Our restaurant is best known for its outstanding Indian Cuisine, excellent staff service with livery ambience. Sitar Indian Cuisine prepares everything fresh using the best quality ingredients and the freshest vegetables. Each dish represents flavor, pleasure, affection and essence.
